name: premiere-project-file-assembly
displayName: Premiere Project File Assembly (go Diego go)
description: Writes Premiere project files from a conversation, a new version each time. A media folder or scan data becomes bins, per-card string-outs, interviews and b-roll, and timecode-synced sequences. --by-folder mirrors your folder tree instead of file dates, for stock or pre-sorted media. A small model inside (MiniLM) groups b-roll by topic and finds every take of a line. Needs Python 3.9+. Verified by reparse; not yet opened in Premiere.
